acquisition method: the data-dependent top10 method was used to acquire MS data
cleavage agent: proteins were digested with trypsin using in-gel digestion at 37 °C
enrichment method: For identification of the membrane proteome, the total membrane fraction was isolated from two biological replicate samples
instrument: coupled to the QExactive mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific)
labeling: Using label-free quantitative proteomics, we identified proteins
reduction reagent: protein samples were reduced with TCEP solution
